description.value:
What more could you want from a weapon spitting homing rounds out of a Smart Link? Poison rounds, obviously. To turn an enemy into Swiss cheese is child's play, but to turn them into a bullet-ridden, steaming pile of liquified remains... that's a job for the Hercules 3AX. 10/10 for style, 2/10 eco-for friendliness.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: Hansen’s not goin’ to let this one off its leash. (Cannot be fabricated, must be gifted or scavenged)

Class: Excellent Quality Machine Gun • Skill: N/A • Range: N/A

Damage: N/A • Capacity: 150 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Auto-Compensator, Bipod, Power Rebuild, TUp (ROF 1, Very Heavy Melee) Stun Bayonet • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Armor-Piercing Ammunition, which for this weapon costs the same as Basic Ammunition. Ammunition purchased for this weapon can only be used by this weapon. Can only fire in Autofire and Suppressive Fire. Using Autofire with this weapon expends 15 rounds instead of 10.

If there are not 15 rounds left in the magazine, Autofire (Machine Gun 4) expends the entire magazine as Autofire (Machine Gun 3). When using Suppressive Fire with this weapon, the user gets a +2 bonus to their Autofire Check.

If this weapon made an Autofire Attack in the previous Round of combat, its Autofire Rating is increased by 1 to a maximum of Autofire (Machine Gun 7), but it expends 5 additional rounds per Autofire Rating increase (20 Rounds at x5, 25 at x5, and 30 at x7). When rolling for Autofire (Machine Gun 6 or 7) damage, it only requires a single d6 damage die to result in a 6 for it to incur a Critical Injury.

Reloading this weapon requires three Reload Actions. Requires BODY 10+ or paired Cyberarms to not reduce the user’s MOVE by 2 while wielded when the weapon is not Mounted.

Fabrication: Hansen’s not goin’ to let this one off its leash. (Cannot be fabricated, must be gifted or scavenged)
Range: N/A
Pre-installed: Auto-Compensator, Bipod, Power Rebuild, TUp (ROF 1, Very Heavy Melee) Stun Bayonet (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Autofire and Suppressive Fire only; 2d6 is the standard Autofire damage.
  • Autofire only, so its DV table is the Autofire table.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
